dispatch_contract.semantics: All accepted keys are non-negative integer counts. Explicit dispatch values replace the default for that key; duplicate explicit values for the same key are summed before replacing the default. Unknown keys warn on stderr and are ignored. Negative counts are rejected so they cannot reduce the estimate. Defaults are conservative pre-gate upper bounds for values /z-plan may not know yet.

accepted_keys.planning_mode_full: 0 for intent-mode baseline; 1 when /z-plan is forced onto the legacy SPEC/PLAN/TASKS path.
accepted_keys.intent_level_depth: 0=quick, 1=standard, 2=deep or not-yet-classified auto; additive depth premium only, consult counts are separate.
accepted_keys.doc_fetcher: Number of doc-fetcher dispatches known before the gate; default 1 if docs may exist.
accepted_keys.explore: Number of Explore dispatches; default 3 is workflow.max_explore's fail-closed cap.
accepted_keys.phase3_consultants: Number of Phase 3 consultant/panel arms expected before the gate; default 5 covers the maximum consultant/panel fan-out.
accepted_keys.phase7_consultants: Number of Phase 7 final-review consultant/panel arms expected before the gate; default 5 covers the maximum consultant/panel fan-out.
accepted_keys.task_tree_generator: 1 when intent-mode will dispatch task-tree-generator; 0 for known legacy/full mode.

execute_forecast.basis: static fallback for post-plan execution; task count, implementer model mix, and review retries are unknown before planning
execute_forecast.user_facing_wording: Projected execute cost is approximate, not exact, and not a hard cap.
